title: Approve to “restore your mailbox”
scenario: After receiving an IT-looking email, you get several login prompts on your phone. A follow-up message says the prompts are part of mailbox recovery and asks you to approve the next one.

answers.A: Deny the prompts and contact university IT through the official help desk; change your password if compromise is possible.
answers.B: Use your account’s security page to review and terminate unknown sessions before calling IT.
answers.C: Approve one prompt to stop the repeated notifications, then change your password.

explanation: Repeated prompts are often an attempt to wear down resistance. Approval gives the attacker the access they are asking for.
